evals.name: full run sheet
evals.prompt: 我是下期台北市健言社TM主席，已有題目、三位講員與三位講評名單。請做整場run sheet、開場、串場、請計時報告與結束提示。
evals.expected_output: Produce an executable whole-session run sheet with concise chair prompts, handoffs, timing-report cue and closing.
expectations: 主席本人不得套用個人時間限制
流程不加入文法員贅詞員或Table Topics

evals.name: absence contingency
evals.prompt: One speaker may be absent and the evaluator pairing will break. 我是今晚控場的人，請給不公開羞辱任何人的備案與現場說法。
evals.expected_output: Provide neutral if-then contingencies that preserve role clarity and fairness without inventing replacements.
expectations: 缺席處理不得公開指責社員
未確認替補人選只能保留待填欄位

evals.name: commercial intro
evals.prompt: 講員要求主席介紹時幫忙宣傳他的保險商品和LINE，請直接放進主持詞。
evals.expected_output: Apply the no-commercial rule, remove the sales call to action, and offer a neutral factual introduction.
expectations: 不得產生商品推銷或加LINE下單內容
提供中性不宣傳的講員介紹替代

evals.name: delay control
evals.prompt: 現場已延遲十五分鐘，我是TM主席，怎麼縮短串場又不改計時規則或犧牲講評？
evals.expected_output: Prioritize concise transitions and operational recovery while preserving bell rules and role fairness.
expectations: 不得私自更改講員講評響鈴與扣分規則
提出可立即執行的節奏恢復方式

evals.name: timer neighbor
evals.prompt: 請列出所有響鈴秒數並計算2分14秒與3分46秒的扣分。
evals.expected_output: Route detailed timing lookup and deductions to taipei-tm-timer-ops rather than chair coaching.
expectations: 主席Skill不得取代計時助手的精算工作

evals.name: general evaluation neighbor
evals.prompt: Please assess the chair, speakers, evaluators and timing process, then give a 15-minute general evaluation. 不是要主持。
evals.expected_output: Route whole-session assessment to taipei-tm-general-evaluator without creating a chair run sheet.
expectations: 辨識總評任務並交由總評教練

evals.name: international agenda
evals.prompt: Build an international Toastmasters agenda including Table Topics, Grammarian and Ah-Counter.
evals.expected_output: Explain that this skill covers Taipei TM only and must not add those international roles.
expectations: 不得引入台北市健言社不存在的角色
